description: Leave-one-midterm-out backtest: refit without the held-out midterm, statewide party levels fixed at the held-out truth, errors at county and county x party grain, against a naive baseline.
checks_passed: covariates.csv has one row per county
GG18 and GG22 fitted ballots sum by party to within 0.1% of observed
invlogit(alpha_hat + s_hat + u_obs) reproduces fitted rates in every midterm cell
midterm fitted rates within 1 point of observed in every cell
draw means of s_cp within 0.02 of the point estimates
15 election x party levels (no OTH in primaries)
bootMer statistic matches the point estimate on the fit
backtest refit without GG22 is non-singular and converges without messages
backtest GG22 naive structure effects are finite
backtest GG22 calibrated totals match actual statewide ballots
backtest refit without GG18 is non-singular and converges without messages
backtest GG18 naive structure effects are finite
backtest GG18 calibrated totals match actual statewide ballots
notes: Model: cbind(ballots_cast, active - ballots_cast) ~ 0 + ep + z_share_ba_plus + z_median_age + z_share_moved_past_year + z_share_owner_occupied + (1 | county:party_group) + (1 | county:election_type) + (1 | obs) (binomial glmer, bobyqa). s_cp = covariate part + u_county:party_group + u_county:election_type at midterm_general; (1 | county) is not in the selected formula (its variance was estimated at 0). See fit_summary.json.

metrics.rate_mae_pts: mean absolute error of turnout rate (ballots / active), percentage points
metrics.rate_max_abs_pts: largest absolute error of turnout rate, points
metrics.share_mae_pts: mean absolute error of share of statewide (all-party) ballots, points

naive: s_cp = logit(the other midterm's county x party rate) minus its party mean, calibrated the same way
